ben.sales: FYI I just uploaded rate_card_v3 to the shared drive and dropped a short release note. Main ask — clarification on discount floors for POCs. BigBank is pushing for 55% off reserved commit for first 6 months. Looping @raj.deals and @elena.finance. Link: https://drive.redwood/rate_cards/v3.json :eyes:

elena.finance: 55% is outside our typical floor. Standard max for commits is 40% unless there are exec-approved exceptions. For POCs we prefer pilot credits or time-limited promos rather than permanent commit discounts. If you want to pursue 55% we need CRO sign-off + legal to vet terms. :thinking_face:

raj.deals: For Dedicated/reserved deals we normally require a 12mo minimum for anything >40%. We can consider 50% if customer commits to 12mo and $500k+ ARR equivalent. For POC specifically, suggest "pilot credits" SKU and a 30/60 day evaluation that converts to a normal commit. I'll kick off the DD workflow. :hammer_and_wrench:

mira.prod: Heads up — rate_card_v3 includes a new POC SKU (pilot_credits_v1) and an explicit version field: "rate_card_v3.0" with effective_date=2026-04-01. That lets sales reference the exact document in the SOW. Recommend using pilot credits + a short conversion incentive.

ben.sales: Good note on versioning. Can you paste the exact JSON snippet for the POC SKU so I can embed in the SOW? Also BigBank wants special terms around data residency + audit rights. Adding cameron.re and sam.security next.

mira.prod: ```json
{"sku":"pilot_credits_v1","units":"credits","notes":"one-time non-refundable, converts to commit at conversion table","list_price":100000}
```

cameron.re: I'll own the SOW template update. @sam.security — BigBank is asking for customer-managed KMS + SOC2 + ISO27001 and SSO via SAML. For Hosted API they want a BAA and data residency controls. Can we support KMS for hosted?

sam.security: Customer-managed KMS is supported for Private deployments and Dedicated with a config add-on. Hosted can be negotiated but requires contract + additional controls. SOC2/ISO are fine. We'll need a short architecture call (30m) to confirm the threat model before committing to any unusual language. Please share the questionnaire; I'll start answers. :lock:

deal-bot: New deal desk request created: DD-2026-033. Link: https://tools.redwood/deal/ DD-2026-033. Status: awaiting deal desk intake.

raj.deals: I submitted an initial intake and proposed route: pilot credits + conversion to reserved commit with a 12mo term. If finance will pre-approve pilot credits up to $50k we can avoid exec loop for the POC. If they insist on a >50% list discount we need exec approval.

elena.finance: I can pre-approve pilot credits up to $50k and a one-time 45% concession on conversion pricing for strategic accounts. Anything beyond that goes to the finance committee. Please include expected ARR if conversion happens.

ben.sales: Got it — I'll offer pilot credits + 45% conversion concession and ask for a 12mo commit if they convert. I'll update the SOW with the exact rate_card_v3 version string and attach the security checklist. Thanks everyone, I'll ping when BigBank responds. :thumbsup:
